text:
mina: spotting a weird pattern: some mTLS handshakes failing with KMS error 'InvalidGrantToken' after our canary rollout at 04:22 UTC
ryan: saw that too in us-west-2 proxies. stacktrace shows decrypt attempt using a grantToken and KMS returning InvalidGrantToken
jorge: which change touched grants? I applied a PR to remove CreateGrant from the mtls-canary role to reduce blast radius (thinking deprivileged canary)
mina: so canary creates a short-lived grant for the proxy to decrypt ephemeral keys during the test. without CreateGrant the grant creation fails or the grant token is not usable
ryan: logs show two failure modes: (1) grant creation failed -> no token returned, (2) grant created but proxy used a stale grantToken (we reuse token across retries) -> KMS says InvalidGrantToken
security-bot: alert: 34 failed handshakes in us-west-2 and 7 in eu-central within 3m; KMS errors: InvalidGrantToken, AccessDenied for CreateGrant
audit-bot: sampling policy set to 3% for mtls_events; redaction hides grantToken and full key ARNs by default, which makes recreating the sequence tricky
infra-oncall: mitigation: revert mtls-canary role to include kms:CreateGrant and kms:RetireGrant temporarily at 04:28 UTC; proxies recovered ~40s after revert, handshakes dropped to baseline
mina: immediate follow-ups: (A) avoid removing CreateGrant from canary role until we redesign grant lifecycle (B) add canary idempotency to avoid reusing grant tokens between attempts (C) increase mtls_event sampling to 25% in affected regions for 6h
jorge: longer term: two design fixes: (1) shift canary to use KMS symmetric data key flow without grants (GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext + Decrypt) in regions that don't need cross-account grants, (2) if grants are required, have the canary create a grant and ensure the token lifecycle is single-use and bound to the request context with a short TTL
ryan: action items: write a small library `kms-grant-util` that wraps CreateGrant+RetireGrant with safe usage patterns, and include tests that simulate token reuse -> fail loudly
mina: also update RBAC change playbook: any PR removing kms:CreateGrant from roles referenced by mtls or canary flows must include a recorded canary run id and a grant-lifecycle rationale
audit-bot: recommendation: for incidents capture unredacted mtls_event payloads into secure-audit-bucket with envelope encryption and 90d retention; also log KMS Grant API calls in cloudtrail with full requestParameters for 30d
infra-oncall: I'll post an audit sampling override now: `POST /audit/overrides { "match":"event:mtls_event AND region:us-west-2", "rate":0.25, "ttl":"6h" }`
jorge: I'll revert the RBAC PR permanently and submit a follow-up that either restores CreateGrant for canaries or refactors canary to avoid grants.
ryan: I'll prototype `kms-grant-util` this afternoon and open PR with unit tests and an integration job that runs in staging for every grant-related change
mina: creating incident INC-2026-0599 and assigning postmortem to @jorge and @ryan. Please attach: proxy logs, cloudtrail KMS Grant events, helm diff for canary, k8s events, and the failed mtls_event samples we captured
security-bot: incident logged and recommended artifacts checklist attached
mina: thanks. once PRs are up we'll run a controlled canary and then close this thread :thumbsup:
